answer: Require each agent to lock a refundable bond and build a verifiable work history before it can earn: like a trellis, genuine reputations grow slowly along checked attestations, while a sudden gale of new identities cannot fake months of consistent service. A public beacon publishes each agent stake, past work, and penalties, so creating many fake identities means paying many bonds and losing them all if caught cheating. Attack cost scales with every fake identity, while honest agents pay once.
